personality_one_liner: A slick, modern, minimalist luxury charter experience where content breathes and stark monochrome contrast signals exclusivity.

spacing.rule: Editorial spacing: generous vertical padding. Let the text and images breathe. Sections should have 48pt spacing between them.

do's: Sticky header backgrounds over scrolling content

screens.name: Home (Fleet Browsing)
screens.purpose: Showcase the Bombardier and Gulfstream fleet with stark, edge-to-edge minimalist luxury.

states.empty: Illustration of a solitary jet. 'No jets available.'
states.error: Failed to load fleet, retry button.

screens.layout: Use a vertical scroll of large, edge-to-edge jet images on white backgrounds. Below each jet image, display the name in Playfair Display (24pt) and 4 minimal tabular stats (range, pax, speed, hourly rate) in DM Sans.

screens.name: Charter Quote
screens.purpose: Allow members to request a quote with a minimalist flight route visualization.
screens.layout: Top half is a stark white canvas with a single sweeping SVG dashed arc between two airport codes (e.g., SFO -> DXB) in 24pt bold. Below, simple input rows for Date, Pax, Jet type. A sticky black 'Request Quote' CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: My Trips
screens.purpose: List past and upcoming requested quotes with their status.

states.empty: Illustration of a solitary jet. 'No upcoming journeys.'

screens.layout: Editorial list layout. Each row has the route code prominently, date, and a pill-shaped status indicator. Generous padding (16pt or 24pt) between rows, separated by a 0.5pt divider.

screens.name: AI Concierge
screens.purpose: Direct access to luxury support via chat.
screens.layout: Minimal chat interface. Messages on surfaceSecondary (gray) for AI and brandPrimary (black) for user. Input field fixed above the keyboard.

instructions_to_main_agent: IMPORTANT: The problem statement explicitly requires 'Clean minimal illustrations of the jets on white backgrounds'. The image selector returned tarmac/sky photos. You MUST use image_generation_tool (if available) to generate minimalist illustrations of a Bombardier Global, Challenger, and Gulfstream on a PURE WHITE background to override the unsplash fallback URLs.
Implement the 'Charter Quote' map as a stylized SVG arc on a white background, NOT real map tiles, matching the 'slick modern minimalist' requirement.
Use tabular numbers ('tabular-nums') for all flight stats (speed, pax, range, price) so they align perfectly in the editorial layout.
Maintain the Editorial LIGHT theme: stark monochrome contrast (Black and White) with only subtle muted champagne/gold accents for luxury. NO BLUES OR PURPLES.
Ensure 'Request Quote' is a sticky CTA at the bottom of the scrollable content in the quote request screen.
